objective: Switch the Arabic site to English, find a procedure, try the 3D simulator, change theme, return home.
device: iPhone 13 (Playwright descriptor: 390×664, DPR 3, iOS Safari UA) — rendered by Chromium
test: journeys\persona-c.spec.js › Persona C — English mobile user

steps.action: Tap the "EN" language button in the header
steps.expected: English LTR home at /en/, scrolled to top, English heading
steps.actual: /en/ lang=en dir=ltr h1="Dr. Maan bin Abdullah Al Barry" y=0

steps.expected: Seven English cards scroll past; each has a title and a details link ≥44px tall
steps.actual: 7 cards seen: Cataract surgery, Lens implants (IOLs), Laser vision correction, Implantable contact lens (ICL), Keratoconus & corneal cross-linking (CXL), Corneal transplant (keratoplasty), Intravitreal injections; smallest link 44px

steps.action: Tap "Procedure details" on the cataract card
Look for a way to jump to the 3D walkthrough near the top of the page
steps.expected: A visible "3D walkthrough" link within the first two screens
steps.actual: 2 in-page links to #cataract-3d; visible within 2 screens: [{"y":679,"visible":true,"h":44}]

steps.action: Reach the 3D section (shortcut link if present, otherwise swipe) and tap "Start the 3D experience"
steps.expected: The 3D viewer mounts in English and is ready
steps.actual: reached via shortcut link; state=ready; title="Cataract surgery, step by step"; stage "The cloudy natural lens"

steps.action: Tap Next twice, then Previous once
steps.expected: Stage counter goes 1 → 3 → 2 and the panel text follows
steps.actual: Stage 1 of 7 → Stage 3 of 7 → Stage 2 of 7 ("Preparing and viewing the front of the eye")

steps.action: Tap Play, wait, then drag the timeline scrubber to the middle
steps.expected: Playback runs; scrubbing jumps to a later stage
steps.actual: playing mode=pause scrubber=139; after tap at 60% scrubber=605, Stage 5 of 7

steps.action: Tap the theme switch in the header
steps.expected: Site and 3D viewer switch to dark; choice saved

steps.action: Check the 3D controls on this phone
Scroll up and tap the "Dr. Maan Al Barry" wordmark
steps.expected: Back on the English home at the top, still dark; at most one 3D instance alive (the home page also hosts the 3D section, so the open viewer is carried over by design)
steps.actual: /en/ lang=en theme=dark y=0; 3D instances=1; live WebGL contexts=1
